jobs.title: Senior Legal Adviser
jobs.reason: The "Senior" title and legal-adviser function require both seniority and a legal qualification the candidate lacks. Despite the perfect accountability/justice subject match, this fails on level and qualification.

jobs.title: Advisory Board Member
jobs.reason: An advisory board role is a senior, expert-level appointment, not an entry-level paid position for an early-career candidate. The level is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Internship - Speculative Opportunities
jobs.reason: This is an internship and speculative posting with no concrete vacancy, both excluded by policy. The field fits, but the type is disqualifying.

jobs.title: Legal Adviser
jobs.reason: A legal-adviser role at an international law foundation requires a legal qualification and admission to practise, which the candidate does not hold. The accountability/justice mission is a perfect interest match but the qualification is an unmet essential.

jobs.title: OSINT Trainer and Safety Protocol Developer
jobs.reason: A "Trainer" and "Safety Protocol Developer" role requires established OSINT-training expertise and safety-protocol experience the candidate does not have; this is a specialist, not an entry-level, position. Although OSINT and atrocity documentation are core interests, the role demands prior domain seniority the candidate lacks.

jobs.title: Speculative Application
jobs.reason: This is a talent-pool / speculative posting with no concrete vacancy, which is excluded by policy. No specific role to assess.

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member – Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established "experts" to sit on an Advisory Committee, not a paid entry-level role — it is an advisory/volunteer-type appointment seeking senior subject-matter specialists, which fails both the paid-role and entry-level tests. The human-rights subject is on-mission, but the candidate does not meet the expert-advisor level required.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.reason: "Principal" is a senior title requiring proven experience leading large-scale enterprise technology platforms and deep SAP / architecture / security expertise — far beyond the candidate's level and skills. The role is also entirely outside the candidate's research and policy interest zones.
jobs.location: London (also Birmingham, Cardiff, Glasgow, Newcastle, Salford; hybrid)

jobs.title: Director
jobs.reason: A Director role providing executive and public leadership over a senior team of three Deputy Directors — clearly a senior, top-level position requiring years of leadership experience the candidate does not have. The disqualifier is the level, not the field; the £80k–£95k salary and permanent executive remit confirm the mismatch.

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established experts to sit on an advisory committee, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks recognised specialists / activist experts (and the Spanish version implies fluency helps), which the candidate is not. It is effectively a voluntary advisory / talent-pool posting rather than a genuine paid position, so it is ineligible despite the human-rights subject matter.

jobs.title: Mystery Shopper (Spain)
jobs.reason: This is a flexible freelance side-gig explicitly framed for students and occasional income, not a genuine professional role, and it requires being based in Spain. It has no connection to the candidate's research, policy or intelligence interests and involves no relevant skills.
jobs.location: Madrid / across Spain (esp. Zaragoza, Lleida, Ibiza, Mallorca)

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an advisory committee, not a paid entry-level role — it is a volunteer/advisory position seeking established specialists on environmental human-rights defenders, which the candidate is not. The human-rights subject is on-mission, but it is neither a genuine paid vacancy for the candidate nor at their level.

jobs.title: Head of Digital Marketing & Performance
jobs.reason: This is a senior "Head of" leadership role requiring 10+ years of experience and deep hands-on digital-marketing expertise, which fails both the seniority and specialist-skills gates. It is entirely outside the candidate's profile and interest zones.

jobs.title: Editor, Branded Content
jobs.reason: This is a commercial content-marketing / branded-content editor role centred on client management, sales support, project delivery and content production for corporate clients — a partial fit at best, since the candidate's strengths are policy/academic research rather than editorial-agency work with senior-exec client presence and vendor management. It leans on comms/marketing and client-facing experience the candidate largely lacks, and it sits outside the three core interest zones, so it is eligible but a weak, low-priority match.

jobs.title: Senior Finance Officer-Sahel
jobs.reason: Location fails the London-only filter — the role is based in Niamey, Niger, with no London or remote-UK option. Separately, it is a senior finance role outside the candidate's skills and interest zones.

jobs.title: Assessment Lead Officer (INTERNAL)
jobs.reason: This is flagged as an INTERNAL vacancy, open only to existing SOAS staff, so an external candidate cannot apply. It is also an administrative assessment/exam-board coordination role with no research or policy content and no alignment with the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: LECTURER.2.01 (AC.08.4) — Programme Co-Lead: Innovation and Technology Acceleration
jobs.reason: Requires an already-completed PhD (in a STEM/engineering field) plus mining-industry experience and a lecturer-level leadership profile — all essentials the candidate does not hold. The subject (mining digitalisation, automation, AI) is also entirely outside the candidate's interest zones and skills.

jobs.title: Associate Lecturer (Researcher: Innovation and Technology Acceleration)
jobs.reason: Requires as an essential a master's degree in mining engineering plus demonstrated experience in mining digitalisation, automation, AI or smart-mining technologies — qualifications and a technical field entirely outside the candidate's profile. This is both a hard qualification mismatch and far from any interest zone.

jobs.title: Faculty Finance Officer (AD09) (AD.09.4)
jobs.reason: The role requires an essential National Diploma in Accounting (NQF 6) plus accounting-policy and financial-IT/Oracle experience, none of which the candidate holds — this is a specialist finance-administration post, not an entry-level research role. It also sits entirely outside the candidate's research, policy and intelligence interest zones.
jobs.location: Johannesburg, South Africa (Faculty of Health Sciences)

jobs.title: Supporter Care Advisor (7384)
jobs.reason: This is an entry-level customer-service / supporter-care role whose requirements (customer-facing experience, written communication, attention to detail) the candidate can nominally meet, so it is eligible. However, it is a donor-service / fundraising-support role with no research or analysis content, sitting well outside all three core interest zones — it offers no meaningful paper fit to the candidate's research profile and only marginal appeal.
jobs.type: Full-time (Agency Temp, 30 weeks, until end Feb 2027)

jobs.title: Associate, Asia
jobs.reason: Genuinely entry-level (bachelor's + one year relevant experience, which RA/project-admin work plus the €1.7m funding administration plausibly satisfies), and the desk research, writing, editing and organisational tasks map well to the candidate's profile; the fluent-Asian-language line is only "preferred", not essential. It sits at a leading human-rights organisation in London, close to the core mission, though the Asia regional focus is outside the candidate's European/atrocity-justice specialism and the role is heavily administrative rather than research-led, which holds it below the top band.

jobs.title: Head of Film and Audio
jobs.reason: A "Head" role requiring significant experience, team and budget management, and essential specialist skills (Adobe Audition/Premiere/Photoshop, digital media production, distribution platforms) that the candidate does not hold — clearly not entry-level. It also sits entirely outside the candidate's research/policy interests, in communications media production.
jobs.salary: £53,949–£62,160 pa (progression to £69,073), inclusive of London allowance

jobs.title: Programme Associate
jobs.reason: The role is explicitly open to internal LSE applicants only (a secondment) — external applications will not be considered, which is a hard blocker. Beyond that, it is an events/marketing/programme-coordination role in entrepreneurship support, far from the candidate's interest zones and requiring essential events, marketing-campaign and community-management experience the candidate largely lacks.

jobs.title: Deputy Head, Digital Experience & Website
jobs.reason: A Deputy Head marketing-leadership role requiring senior experience leading digital transformation, CRM/Salesforce implementation and website redevelopment — well beyond entry-level and demanding years of relevant senior marketing experience the candidate lacks. It also sits outside all three interest zones. Multiple unmet essentials trigger the hard disqualifier.
jobs.salary: £53,949 to £62,160 pa (progressing to £69,073) inclusive of London allowance

jobs.title: Immigration and Public Law Solicitor
jobs.reason: Requires a qualified solicitor with IAAS accreditation and senior caseworker experience — a legal qualification and seniority the candidate does not hold. The asylum/human-rights subject is a strong interest match, but the essential legal qualification is an unmet hard requirement.

jobs.title: Executive Officer (part-time)
jobs.reason: The posting gives no detail on level or requirements, but an executive-officer administrative role plausibly fits the candidate's project-administration and stakeholder-management experience. Public-law charity work is only tangential to the core interest zones, and the lack of any detail keeps this marginal.

jobs.title: Community Network Manager
jobs.reason: A "Manager" title signals a non-entry-level role, which is a hard mismatch for a candidate with no full-time professional experience. Community-network work is also outside the core interest zones.

jobs.title: Data Solution Architect
jobs.reason: This is a senior, deep-technical data-architecture role requiring proven experience designing and scaling data-intensive applications, cloud data platforms and data-warehousing methodologies — far beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python and with no matching professional experience. It is both a hard skills mismatch and clearly not entry-level, so it is ineligible.

jobs.title: Data Analytics Specialist
jobs.reason: This is a specialist digital web-analytics role whose essential requirements — hands-on GA4/GTM implementation, BigQuery/SQL validation at scale, and tag-management measurement engineering — are a technical skill set the candidate's analysis-level Python and SPSS do not meet. It also sits entirely outside all three interest zones, and its domain (web-measurement engineering) has no overlap with the candidate's policy/research profile.
